title: Arquitectura multilingüe nativa i18n (es/en/pt/ja)
description: Diccionarios JSON por idioma (es base, en, pt, ja), selector global de idioma vinculado al perfil Supabase, refactor de todo texto estático a claves i18n, y adaptación del prompt de sistema de los agentes IA al idioma activo.

classification.rationale: Classified as COMPLEX complexity. Complexity drivers: 25 files affected, schema changes required, AI behaviour changes, cross-cutting (multi-domain), category requires council. Required agents (10): architect, database, backend, frontend, ai_engineer, performance, security, qa, release, memory_engineer.

decisions.rationale: Aprobado: i18n nativo sin romper multi-tenant, RLS ni dominio de ventas
